response.sql:
SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS conserved_site_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
GROUP BY s.insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: Counts conservation records as conserved sites; the schema allows multiple conservation records for one site.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct sites with at least one conservation record in each insurance-status group.
alternatives.sql:
SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS conserved_site_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry)) OVER () AS share
FROM scanconservation AS c
JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref
GROUP BY s.insurstat;
